# THE CURFEW SWEEP: HAB BLOCK C, 0300 [color=#7A6F68]Pinned. Accounts from the people who were in the block that night. If you were there, add what you saw from where you were standing.[/color]
### #1 corridor_nine (OP) // 83.04.02 Two days after somebody painted a fist on the water tower, GOVFOR came through block C at three in the morning. No announcement on the speakers, no knock. The doors were opened with a ram, one after another down the corridor, and the noise woke the floor before they reached us.
Everybody out, face down on the corridor deck in whatever we slept in. Hands on the back of the head. My neighbour's grandfather has a hip held together with pins. He could not get down, so two of them put him down. He stayed there two hours with his cheek on the plating. When he asked for water they told him to stop talking.
They searched every room. They took a stack of my son's picture books because one had a drawing of a fist on the cover. It was a boxing story.
Men between about sixteen and fifty were walked to the garrison gym. Most came back the next afternoon. Three did not.
### #2 old_kettle // 83.04.02 Floor two, end room. Can confirm the times. I looked at my clock when the first door went, 0258. They were gone by 0510. The administration notice on the board the next morning called it [italic]a routine residency verification conducted with the cooperation of residents.[/italic]
I did not cooperate. I lay on the floor.
### #3 loyal_and_tired // 83.04.03 Somebody painted insurgent symbols on colony property and people are surprised the garrison came looking? The cell hides in blocks like C. If you want the soldiers to stop kicking in doors, stop hiding the people who give them a reason. This board is a CLF recruiting page with extra steps.
### #4 ledger_keeper (mod) // 83.04.03 This board takes no side in the war and takes no money from anyone in it. We would post this account if the people kicking in doors wore CLF armbands, and we have.
loyal_and_tired, your post stays up. You are allowed to think the sweep was necessary. Nobody here is allowed to pretend an old man with a pinned hip was hiding a rifle under his cheek.
### #5 lance_nobody // 83.04.05 I was in the stack that night. I am not going to say which squad.
We were briefed that block C held a weapons cache and at least two cell members who had fired on a patrol. We were told to expect resistance. Most of us are twenty. We were scared out of our minds, and scared soldiers grab people harder than they need to and shout louder than they need to. That is not an excuse. That is just how it happened.
We found one flare gun and a box of fireworks left over from the founding day festival. No rifles. No cell. The briefing was wrong or somebody lied, and either way nobody above me ever said so.
I am sorry about the grandfather. I was the one who brought him water when the sergeant was outside. I know it does not fix anything.
### #6 corridor_nine (OP) // 83.04.05 It does not fix anything. But he remembers the water, and he asked me to say thank you if I ever found out who it was. So. Thank you.
### #7 ration_line // 83.04.09 Has anyone else in C noticed the water allocation? Ours dropped by a fifth the week after the sweep. The administration says it is a pump fault. Blocks A and B have no pump fault. My cousin in maintenance says the order came with a garrison stamp on it.
### #8 old_kettle // 83.04.12 Same. Collective punishment, only they will never use the word, so on paper it is plumbing.
### #9 corridor_nine (OP) // 83.04.19 Update. One of the three came home last night. He will not talk about the gym. He has two fingers bandaged together on his left hand and he holds his cup with the other one. He says the other two were moved somewhere on a garrison transport on the second day. He does not know where.
### #10 ledger_keeper (mod) // 83.04.19 Thank you for the update. The two still unaccounted for are now posted, with their families' permission, on [netlink="lastseen.deep" link="lastseen.deep"]. If anyone reading this loads garrison transports, you know what we are asking.
Complaint guidance for the water cut is in the [netlink="board index" link="bruises.deep"]. File as a group. A group complaint has to be answered by the administrator in person, at least on paper.
